goal: Strengthen imm-planner so Medium- and High-risk technical planning explicitly selects the materially relevant architecture-layer, interface, data-flow, state-transition, and temporal-sequence views, persists those decisions in the Spec, and uses their boundaries as one dimension of coherent TaskIntent decomposition without reviving prose Plan authority.

acceptance.assertion: The host-visible and packaged Planner contracts require materially relevant technical-design views and define outcome-centered TaskIntent retain/split criteria while preserving Low-risk concision and the Spec as the single design authority.
The elevated-risk planning quality gate carries the same design-view and decomposition checks, and its checked-in packaged mirror is synchronized.
